White letter-size paper with subtle folds, natural indoor light, slight handheld perspective, clean readable black sans-serif print. The full width of the table and all its columns must fit inside the photograph. A thin blue hand-drawn oval circles ONLY the address in the Dept./Address cell, without obscuring letters. Keep substantial blank paper below the table as in the reference. Crop closer than the reference for readable type while preserving portrait orientation and the paper-photo look.
Document layout: large bold practice name at top, practice address and phone/fax below, patient block below that including explicit age and DOB, then bold 'Upcoming Appointments', then one wide outlined appointment table with five labeled columns and one tall data row.
